title: Research: PR3335 rank-34 factors have full-port copy tariff 224 (no kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Scoped cost audit, no new κ.** PR3335 reduces the strict plane-mask fitting rank from 49 to 34 and explicitly leaves native copy pricing open. On its literal 34 supports, this independently implemented checker gives the retained **full-port one-total tariff C = 224**:

| Channel rank | Count | Charge |
|---|---:|---:|
| 4 | 8 | 32 |
| 6 | 8 | 48 |
| 8 | 18 | 144 |

Each touched scalar port carries its entire Gram-I2 plane. A support of size k spans k orthogonal planes, so its source/reader pairing rank is 2k. The disjoint supports partition 112 ports: summing gives 224, regardless of how this support-partition construction groups channels. Counting singleton labels gives the incorrect 112; charging rank two once per channel gives 68.

The new scalar fit remains valid: all 12,544 entries, 11,440 forced entries, the forced I34 minor, 280 free scalar corrections and all 224 source/dirty-target columns pass. Its expanded binary transfer is I224, saturating the **prior** integral floor. This does not invalidate PR3335's rank-34 discovery or introduce a new universal decoder floor.

Granting the proposed two-unpaid coverage law, ideal hosting and zero additional overhead, `(71*896 + 224*9)/(73*896) = 293/292 > 1` already fails at zero saving. Stop dependent construction on these literal factors under that contract. A different fractional decoder or physical interface remains open.

Only seven files under `research/paired-plane-rank34-copy-invoice/` are added. No native word, source-acquisition/correction chronology, private-array restoration, physical routing/hosting, precision/tape, all-size interface, complete supplier or selected-frontier change is supplied.

## Task and overlap

Card `coverage-law-change`, priority revision 6, **changed scope**: take PR3335's explicit cost follow-up instead of proposing another coverage law. The bottleneck connection is whether the two-unpaid lever survives its complete copy bill.

- Canonical main/base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, refetched unchanged before submission.
- Exact predecessor: PR3335 `1d46df8b5aeac49d165cae58c1dd1036666bb789`; its certificate is retained byte for byte, with SHA256/Git-blob/source-path provenance.
- Reviewed contribution bytes: `529959bb00abd01664b7109d2e40574ecb0c8da1`. The reachable retention commit is `5685c6288205e463e4ca28355fc3a3458da27334`; replay requires no fetch of an unrelated PR commit.
- Nearest predecessors: PR2203 (direct native payload bill on the old matching), PR1889 (scalar mask), PR2484/2471 (rank witnesses), Philippe Van Velzen's integral floor and retained full-port definitions. This adds the invoice on the **new** literal matching/factors and a code-disjoint endpoint/rank check.
- Complete entry overlap covered 257 open PRs and 2,181 Discussion records; pre-submission refresh covered 258 and 2,187. It revealed a [near-simultaneous same-question claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19007604). Both investigations were independently started; [public coordination and exact evidence](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19007676) propose one focused PR with corroboration here. The [concurrent block-rank audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19007618) is a distinct question. No novelty is inferred from cache misses.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.14, macOS arm64, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-rank34-copy-invoice
```

Both registered normal/optimized commands pass. Each full-port pairing rank is checked by XOR elimination and a finite-set radical/image oracle. Eleven controls reject matching/support/mask/dirty-endpoint defects, two underpriced invoices, source mutations and a type-confused receipt. A separate no-import calculation checks that every support's full-plane Gram matrix is literally I_(2k), corroborating all 34 costs.

Final committed export `529959bb00abd01664b7109d2e40574ecb0c8da1` passes transport checking and direct normal/optimized replay from a read-only source tree with no `.git` and an empty executable PATH. All nine exported files/receipt remain byte-identical. Actual CLI mutations reject changed certificate bytes, a 112-cost receipt and a boolean channel count; an existing output is preserved. The card's `PASS_COMPLEX_LOCAL_WORD_CEILING` orientation control and whitespace checks also pass.

The general support-partition argument is written in README; finite checks bind the actual sources and arithmetic. Native/compiler/supplier obligations listed above, the selected cold replay, hosted CI, formal-kernel proof and independent human review are **not** claimed.

## Open next questions

Can genuinely non-2-integral source/reader factors on these rematched planes meet the required full-port allowance? Start with an exact fractional factorization, its complete scalar mask and all pairing-span charges. A lower channel count within disjoint integral colouring supports cannot supply that improvement. The missing lower-cost factorization blocks further native construction; acquisition, restoration and all-size admission remain additional obligations. See TASK.json for the structured handoff.
